deltas.why: No exact external-cost/benefit market-failure performance was found in the whole original. S.24 belongs to macroeconomics, not the claimed LK market/price source. Sustainability at GK S.19 / optional LK S.26 is not a licence to relabel the old LK market-price atom as an official externality competence.
deltas.consequence: The sole direct BB mapping of EXT is removed in this candidate; the old direct BB EXT source/scope claim loses its support; actual original coverage and role must be rederived, with no invented normative BB externality gap. No historical source/review artifact is deleted or overwritten.
